newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-C.BANK'S RESERVE MONEY UP TO 2.939 BLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-C.BANK'S RESERVE MONEY UP TO 2.939 BLN LITAS.

text.p: The Bank of Lithuania said on Wednesday that its reserve money rose in July to 2.939 billion litas from 2.845 billion litas at the end of June.
The central bank said in a statement that the reserve money included currency in circulation, deposit reserves and demand deposits of other sectors excluding the central government.
The statement also said that the assets of the central bank at the end of July were 4.968 billion litas compared to 4.124 billion litas at the end of June.
Foreign assets of the bank at the end of July were 4.621 billion litas compared to 3.766 billion litas at the end of June, the statement said.
